# FP5 spare parts and screws

Up: [[202310150903 FP5 disassembly flow]]

## Two screws, one driver

| Colour | Size | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Black Phillips | M1.4 | display repairs only |
| Silver Phillips | M1.4 | everything else |

Driver: **Phillips PH00**. Professional torque: **0.8 ± 0.15 KGF**. The two
types are the same thread and different colours — the only thing stopping a
mix-up is paying attention, which is why the document calls it out.

## Screw counts by step

| Step | Screws |
|---|---|
| Display | 8 black |
| Top cover lid | 1 |
| Rear cameras | 6 silver |
| Loudspeaker | 5 silver |

## Tools

Tool 1 alone covers most repairs; 2–8 are for the complex ones.

| # | Tool |
|---|---|
| 1 | Phillips screwdriver PH00 |
| 2 | Prying tool |
| 3 | USB-C cable (to test charging) |
| 4 | Battery discharge power measurement equipment |
| 5 | ESD protection gear |
| 6 | RF connector tool |
| 7 | Soldering gun and tin |
| 8 | Computer with the software flashing tool |

## Parts Fairphone will replace for you

Battery, back cover, display, top unit, wide camera, ultra-wide camera.

Reflow limits, if you are down at that level: preheat 150–180 °C for at most
120 s, soldering above 220 °C for at most 90 s, peak 260 °C for at most 30 s.
